title: Worker exits with status 137 while importing a large catalog
body: Runtime: Go 1.23 on a self-hosted Linux runner. MEMORY_LIMIT=512Mi. Actual result: the worker is killed while importing a 4 GB catalog. Expected result: the import completes or reports a recoverable limit error. Reproduce by starting the worker with the attached catalog.
recommendation_focus: reproduce using the reported memory limit and catalog size

title: Allow callers to filter by a nested metadata key
body: It would help consumers to pass an optional nested-key selector to the search API. Existing calls should keep their current behavior.
recommendation_focus: clarify the optional API contract and preserve existing calls

title: Quickstart still shows the removed callback parameter
body: The quickstart describes the callback argument that was removed in the current release. Please update the example; application behavior is otherwise working.

title: What is the supported way to rotate a client certificate?
body: I have not encountered an error. I want to understand whether rotation can happen without restarting the process.

title: Upgrade fails when a nullable column has existing rows
body: Observed result: the migration exits with a constraint error on PostgreSQL 16. Expected result: existing rows should remain valid. The issue affects one staging database; restoring the previous migration is a temporary workaround.
recommendation_focus: reproduce the migration against existing nullable-column data and preserve rollback

title: Health summary says ready but attached response is unhealthy

title: Reduce allocations during repeated neighborhood queries
body: The benchmark records 14,000 allocations per query at 500,000 vertices. We would like to lower allocation overhead while retaining the current result ordering.
recommendation_focus: reproduce the benchmark and compare allocations while preserving result ordering

title: Read-only members can change invoices in other accounts
body: An integration test confirms that a viewer can update invoices owned by another account. The behavior affects every account in the shared deployment and no workaround is available.
recommendation_focus: treat the reported cross-account unauthorized writes as critical and verify the authorization path

title: Should the animation pause when the tab loses focus?
body: The graph pauses while the tab is in the background and resumes when I return. No exception or incorrect result has been reported; I am asking about the intended behavior.
recommendation_focus: clarify intended background-tab behavior rather than requesting a bug reproducer

title: Worker behavior is confusing
body: The worker is confusing after the recent update. I do not know what it should do differently.

title: Every request is rejected after certificate renewal
body: Since renewal, requests from all clients fail with an authorization response. The production service is unavailable across all regions; rollback has not restored access.
recommendation_focus: triage the broad production outage and inspect the certificate renewal path

title: One operator cannot save a dashboard preference
body: A single operator account sees the save button fail. Reloading the page applies the preference; other operators are unaffected.
recommendation_focus: respect the reported isolated scope and available workaround despite the priority label
